description: 上市前专利排查、新品专利风险初筛。当用户说「新产品上市前查一下有没有专利风险」「这几个功能有没有别人的有效专利」「产品专利排查」「要不要做 FTO」「出货前专利自查」时使用。输出专利排查清单（Excel 能打开），按功能点分组。 Before a product launch, checks each feature for relevant in-force patents, listing the closest ones, their owners and remaining term, as a screening list to decide whether to commission a formal legal analysis.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
